notes: Premise (lessons analysis 1.4, 2.3): in the first repro run kbid.py add took model-written title, publisher, licence, reuse and version in 843 calls (124 with a check: line for a licence guess); of 362 rows of the same source id across instance pairs 6 were byte-identical (licence 221, title 199, version 125, publisher 107, reuse 76 differ). EP-jqjlwiar's clause 'a new source's licence and reuse come from the source's own licence record' is met in part by kbid.py licence (content-rules.md:86); this story makes the rest of the row deterministic. kbid.py add --help at 5834a99e2 requires --title and --publisher. Docs that name kbid.py add without its flags (kb/_self/code.md, maintaining.md, plugin.md, census.py) stay right while the flags remain accepted. Plan review 2026-10-15: the kbid scenarios sit in test_lookup_eval_passes_on_the_live_kb (test_live_kb.py near line 976), not the build_index test. The licence reader is provider.read_licence, which kbid.py add calls when --licence and --reuse are omitted (there is no kbid.py licence subcommand). Gate g2 keeps the 'where read' part of the cell because content-rules.md:80 asks for where the terms are stated; written by the tool from the licence record it is the same for one url in every instance, which is what the 221 differing cells lacked.
